subject: MSA cadence: split review vs consolidated walkthrough
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@trellishealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@trellishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redline workshop & onboarding cadence

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick inbound earlier. We just finished an internal intake and want to lock an MSA redline workshop + onboarding coordination call. The ask: run through Trellis' redline set (legal + security), align on evidence required for our procurement intake, and identify a short follow-up onboarding check-in for engineering + integrations.

Two options from our side that would work for stakeholders here:
- Option A: Consolidated 2-hour session (legal + eng + procurement). Pros: faster alignment; Cons: harder to find a contiguous slot.
- Option B: Split into two 1-hour sessions (legal redlines first, technical onboarding second). Pros: narrower attendee scope + easier scheduling.

Proposed windows next week (Trellis local TZ):
- Tue 30 Jun 09:00–11:00 PDT
- Wed 1 Jul 13:00–15:00 PDT
- Thu 2 Jul 10:00–12:00 PDT

Can you confirm which option you prefer and who from Redwood should join? Also: please send any pre-read or an evidence checklist we should prepare before the call. I can pull our procurement PO status if helpful (we're in approval but want the technical gate cleared ASAP).

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Director, Procurement — Trellis Health

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@trellishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline workshop & onboarding cadence

Hey Alice —

Appreciate the detail. Splitting into two 1-hour sessions (Option B) is the approach we've seen work best for a clean handoff between legal and engineering. We'll plan for: redline review (legal + security) followed by a focused integration checklist call with eng and CS.

From Redwood: I'll lead the redline session (legal liaison), Ben will join for procurement/terms and to speak to routing/fallbacks, and Marissa will surface the evidence pack and onboarding checklist. To keep the call actionable, please share annotated redlines if you have them; if not, we'll review the Trellis changes live but prefer pre-reads when possible.

Suggested slots (we can open calendar invites once you confirm):
- Wed 1 Jul 09:00–10:00 PDT — redline review
- Wed 1 Jul 11:00–12:00 PDT — integration onboarding checklist

If those don't work, Thu 2 Jul 10:00–11:00 PDT and 14:00–15:00 PDT are open on our side.

I'll ask Marissa to attach a short "onboard-evidence-checklist.xlsx" and a redline outline for the session. Ben — if you have any constraints on the 1 Jul morning window, flag now.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@trellishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline workshop & onboarding cadence

+1 to Wed 1 Jul split sessions. I can make the 09:00 redline slot and will stay on the 11:00 onboarding call for the evidence checklist. If Trellis needs a procurement contact for the PO routing, Raj (cc'd earlier) is the right person on your side.

I'll drop calendar holds for the two 1-hr blocks once Alice confirms — will mark as "Redwood / Trellis — MSA redline" and include a short agenda.

On region/compliance — if Trellis has EU-data constraints we should note them now; otherwise we'll default to our standard onboarding runbook.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@trellishealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MSA redline workshop & onboarding cadence — evidence pack

Forwarding with attachments — attaching two small stubs you can download ahead of the meeting:
- onboard-evidence-checklist.xlsx (attachment) — short matrix of artifacts we typically request for procurement (SOC 2, retention controls, network diagrams, SLA language).
- redline-outline.pdf (attachment) — suggested agenda and the Redlined clauses we expect to walk through (definitions, data handling, liability cap, fallback policies).

Link to our read-only folder: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_example

Alice — can you confirm the Trellis attendees for each session (legal team and infra/eng lead for the onboarding call)? If you want, I can split the attendee invites so only the necessary folks are on each hour.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

[Attachments: onboard-evidence-checklist.xlsx, redline-outline.pdf]

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@trellishealth.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@trellishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA redline workshop & onboarding cadence

Thanks — that works. We'll go with the split sessions on Wed 1 Jul:
- 09:00–10:00 PDT — Trellis legal (Alice, Raj) + Redwood legal (Hannah) + Ben
- 11:00–12:00 PDT — Trellis eng (Maya Singh, infra lead) + Redwood eng/CS (Marissa, Ben)

I've asked our legal to push annotated redlines into the shared folder by EOD Monday. PO is in final approval; Raj will follow up on procurement timeline. For the invites please keep the attendee lists tight (legal-only for the first hour).

I'll accept the calendar holds once they land. Appreciate the quick turnaround — this should keep our onboarding runway intact.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Director, Procurement — Trellis Health
